description: What an item actually sold for at U.S. government auctions: real winning bids (not dealer or eBay prices) with the median, the middle range, the low and high, prices by model year and the most recent individual sales with links. Use for questions like 'what does a used police Tahoe sell for at auction?'

days.description: Look back this many days (7 to 1095, default 365)

limit.description: How many individual sales to list (1 to 100, default 15)

query.description: Item to price, e.g. "2019 chevrolet tahoe police" or "ford f-250"

sort.description: Order of the individual sales listed (default newest)

state.description: Optional U.S. state name or 2-letter code

name: get_sold_prices
title: What it sold for at government auctions
